label: wave26-stages-b-peer-visual-review
scope: Separate integration review from the native harness author and root primary reviewer. This reviewer authored the native stage plates; authorship is disclosed and this is not independent validation of source fidelity.
method: Actually opened the original 1280x720 native FightEngine PNG with view_image. Recomputed its SHA256 and matched the exact capture record in the individually hashed native report. No contact sheet, thumbnail or regenerated image substituted for the viewed PNG.

findings: Viewed original 1280x720 native FightEngine capture: gray-blue ice banks, embedded broken brickwork, dark upper gap and thin bent pole remain legible.
Both existing test fighters are wholly visible with feet on the broad level frozen floor. Their weapons and silhouettes clear the scene geometry and the small outer-edge foreground ice.
HUD names, health bars and center stage information remain visible. No embedded player, Raw Shock, reticle, weather effect or puzzle actor is visible.
sourceLimits: The source is Wii promotional gameplay screenshot 38 in the gallery section dated 2009-07-31, before release. The exact street, route chapter and final-build match are unverified.
The source slope, depth and obstructions have been adapted into a flat side-on versus floor. The broad wall span, pole placement, unseen surfaces and ice geometry are authored reconstruction.

The dark upper gap and exposed fragments are artwork features, not independently reconstructed geographic continuity. No source chase, weather behavior, collision, hazard, timing or 1:1 fidelity is certified.

limits: This visual review is limited to the stated still capture at frame 229. Native harness assertions are quoted from the bound report, not independently rerun by this reviewer.
The bound report declares browserTest=false, httpTest=false and actorStateInjected=false. This review does not certify Chromium, DOM/CSS, HTTP, real browser keyboard delivery or service workers.

Two static image planes plus runtime parallax do not constitute a new source animation. No new fighter pose, attack, contact, guard, finisher, hazard, weather, collision or gameplay behavior is certified.
The native foreground retains tiny alpha 1/255 traces, as recorded by the plate analysis; visual clearance does not assert that every central alpha byte is zero.
Source fidelity remains unverified. Acceptance covers the observed framing, floor readability, HUD visibility and absence of foreground obstruction in this exact capture.
